Small, pinned snapshots so nothing here depends on a live service.

| File                 | Source                                                                                                                    | License                                                                                                          |
|----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ground_truth.json    | Generated reference numbers for the checks                                                                                | CC0                                                                                                              |
| scene.json           | The window, the mask rule, the blocks and their split, the chips, the lecture's numbers and the choices the pipeline made | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work                                                                |
| layers.gpkg          | The window's outline and the 25 blocks with their role (the course), the footprints of block 7 (OpenStreetMap)            | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work; the footprints ODbL 1.0, copyright OpenStreetMap contributors |
| chips.csv            | The 1,600 tiled chips: row and column, block, split, roof share and label                                                 | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work                                                                |
| window_2m4.tif       | NAIP 2023 over the window, red, green and blue averaged to 2.4 m                                                          | Public domain, USDA                                                                                              |
| mask_2m4.tif         | The roof share of every 2.4 m cell from the OpenStreetMap footprints, centre-in rule                                      | ODbL 1.0, copyright OpenStreetMap contributors                                                                   |
| prob_2m4.tif         | The fine-tuned U-Net's probability of roof over the window, averaged to 2.4 m                                             | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work                                                                |
| block_7.tif          | NAIP 2023 over block 7 at 0.3 m, red, green and blue                                                                      | Public domain, USDA                                                                                              |
| mask_7.tif           | The mask of block 7 from the OpenStreetMap footprints, centre-in rule                                                     | ODbL 1.0, copyright OpenStreetMap contributors                                                                   |
| prob_7_finetuned.tif | The fine-tuned U-Net's probability of roof on block 7, chip centres kept                                                  | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work                                                                |
| prob_7_frozen.tif    | The frozen-encoder U-Net's probability of roof on block 7, chip centres kept                                              | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work                                                                |
| chip_features.npz    | The 512 frozen and the 512 fine-tuned numbers of every tiled chip, with labels, split, block and share                    | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work; the ImageNet weights BSD 3-Clause, torchvision                |
| segmenter_frozen.npz | The frozen-encoder U-Net of the lecture, every weight as float16                                                          | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work; the encoder's ImageNet weights BSD 3-Clause, torchvision      |
| train_chips.npz      | 24 training chips with their masks, chosen by rule                                                                        | Public domain, USDA; the masks ODbL 1.0, copyright OpenStreetMap contributors                                    |
| first_batch.npz      | The 32 chips of the first batch of the lecture's chip classifier, with their masks and labels                             | Public domain, USDA; the masks ODbL 1.0, copyright OpenStreetMap contributors                                    |
| curves.json          | The lecture's training curves and test numbers, the U-Net runs and the chip classifier                                    | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work                                                                |
| evolution.npz        | One validation chip's probability map after every epoch of the main run                                                   | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work                                                                |
| street_nassau.jpg    | One Mapillary image of Nassau Street, 11 November 2024, faces and plates blurred by the platform                          | CC BY-SA 4.0, Mapillary contributors, image 1211673680555546                                                     |
| street_nassau.npz    | The image's SegFormer-B0 label map with the nineteen Cityscapes classes, their names and palette                          | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI, the course's own work; the model NVIDIA                                              |
